asset.Name: Better Base
asset.Description:
A single all-in-one base overhaul: faster construction, more useful buildings and cheaper running costs, tuned to stay below the extreme values of the original Better Buildings mods.

CONSTRUCTION TIME
- Hangar, generators, access lift: 6 days (was 12)
- Quarters, stores, medbays, radar, turrets, quantum decoder: 9 days (was 15)
- Labs, workshops, training centre, radar tier 2: 12 days (was 20)

BUILDINGS
- Stores: 500 capacity (was 100)
- Living quarters: 500 personnel (was 10)
- Generator: 250 power (was 40)
- Alenium generator: 500 power (was 80)
- Medbay: 3 HP/day healing, 50% survival (was 2 / 20%)
- Advanced medbay: 6 HP/day healing, 100% survival (was 2.5 / 30%)
- Training centre: 50 soldiers (was 12)
- Labs and workshops (all tiers): 10 staff slots (was 4-5)

COSTS
- Engineers and scientists: $5,000 to hire, $2,500/month upkeep (was $50,000 / $25,000)
- Every building: $2,500/month upkeep (was $25,000-$120,000)

COMPATIBILITY
- Replaces the building templates and the engineer/scientist masters: do not use together with Better Buildings (or its AIO) or any mod that edits the same files.
- New build times apply to construction started after the mod is enabled.
asset.Author: andreacw96
asset.Credits: Values based on the Better Buildings mods
